about: Vice City's four releases as one timeline: the first Grand Theft Auto (1997, top-down, three cities, Vice City one of them), GTA Vice City (2002, story set in 1986), Vice City Stories (2006, set in 1984), and GTA 6 (November 19, 2026, Vice City in the state of Leonida). 1997 to 2026 is 29 years by release year; no exact birthday is claimed because the 1997 day is disputed. Delta channel, own flat graphics only. Narration-led: the voice is recorded first and every visual beat is keyed to its word times.
